findings.title: release.yml fails on every promotion (SIGPIPE exit 141), so no tag/release/SBOM attachment is produced

Consequence: origin has 0 tags and 0 releases (git ls-remote --tags; /releases), the lockfile SBOM is never attached, and every promotion shows a red Release run. Fix: use `git log -n 100` (no pipe), or drop pipefail for that pipeline, or `|| true`; then re-run the release for 7dd0402. Validation: Release run green and `git ls-remote --tags` shows v0.1.0-<date>-7dd0402.
